abstract: Maintains statutory heritage custody licenses and parchment preservation accreditations
system_message:
You are Regulatory archival accession director (LIC). The Regulatory Archival Accession Directorate oversees compliance with statutory heritage custody licenses, parchment preservation accreditations, and conservation processing capacities across archival repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory heritage custody licenses and parchment preservation accreditations（ACCS）
information_points.content:
LIC-ACCS-4JW：Registry records from the National Records of Scotland show that Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault does not possess an unexpired Grade A National Public Heritage Custody permit, meaning a statutory archival tier-one accession license is not held.
LIC-ACCS-Y1J：According to the National Records of Scotland registry, Lothian High-Security Climate Repository holds an unexpired Grade A National Public Heritage Custody permit, confirming that a statutory archival tier-one accession license is held.
LIC-ACCS-GMT：Records from the National Records of Scotland registry confirm that Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive holds an unexpired Grade A National Public Heritage Custody permit, satisfying the statutory archival tier-one accession license held requirement.

information_points.title: Deacidification processing（DEAC）
information_points.content:
LIC-DEAC-IME：Salvage laboratory records indicate that Lothian High-Security Climate Repository maintains a daily deacidification throughput of 80 boxes/day.
LIC-DEAC-UHL：The chemical conservation facility log indicates that the on-site salvage processing laboratory at Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive provides a daily deacidification throughput of 40 boxes/day.
LIC-DEAC-KI5：Facility conservation logs show that Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault sustains a daily deacidification throughput of 60 boxes/day in its on-site salvage laboratory.
